annotations.text:
Original characters live in the same slots as normal characters.
Regional on: two slots, Left and Right - either can hold a normal character or an OC. The four-column row (Character L/R + Original L/R) is gone.
Click a slot: the picker shows both kinds in one list; the Character / Original chips filter it. An OC in a slot shows a small OC badge.

Regional off: the fixed 'Original Character' slot is gone too. Any of the 1-6 slots may hold an OC; + / - keep working.
OC picks are stored as oc:<name>, so saved settings and presets keep their shape.

Strength is 0-10 in steps of 0.1 but lives around 1.0, so it is a number box next to the side's area (same 40px box as the character weight) instead of a full-width slider. Ratio and overlap keep their sliders.
